name: Hirogawa (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Hirogawa town emblem in white: a ring with two horn-like strokes rising from the top.
history: Municipal flag of Hirogawa, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Hirogawa town emblem — a ring with two horn-like strokes rising from the top
